title: Option Deposit Rate Table for the Design Studio Selections Packages
content:
Studio Accounting rates for option deposits on Design Studio Selections files are set per package as follows. All percentages are percentages of the price of the option lines (or of the stated part of the option total) to which they are applied.

| Package | Structural deposit percent | Finish deposit percent | Deposit ladder threshold (option total, USD) | Elevated ladder percent | Option cap (percent of the agreement's base price) | Deposit percent on the part of the option total above the option cap | Deposit due (business days after the line is selected) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 100 | 25 | 25000.00 | 50 | 10 | 100 | 5 |
| Studio Classic | 75 | 25 | 35000.00 | 50 | 12 | 100 | 5 |
| Studio Select | 50 | 25 | 50000.00 | 50 | 15 | 100 | 5 |
| Studio Designer | 50 | 25 | 75000.00 | 50 | 18 | 100 | 5 |
| Studio Signature | 50 | 25 | 125000.00 | 50 | 20 | 100 | 7 |
| Studio Atelier | 50 | 20 | 200000.00 | 50 | 25 | 100 | 7 |

**Definitions used in the table**

- *Structural deposit percent* — the package's percent for structural, electrical and plumbing option lines.
- *Finish deposit percent* — the package's percent for finish option lines.
- *Deposit ladder threshold* — the option total, in US dollars, above which the elevated ladder percent comes into play.
- *Elevated ladder percent* — the package's elevated deposit percent tied to the ladder threshold.
- *Option cap* — a percentage of the purchase agreement's base price; the part of the option total above it is the part above the option cap.
- *Deposit due* — the number of business days after an option line is selected by which the deposit shortfall it creates is to be paid.

*Hypothetical illustration of the option cap:* on a Studio Designer file whose purchase agreement has a base price of 500000.00, the option cap is 18 percent of 500000.00, that is 90000.00; an option total of 95000.00 stands 5000.00 above the option cap.
